headline: Diversified Energy Closes $1.8 Billion Acquisition in Permian Basin
summary: Diversified Energy has completed its $1.8 billion acquisition of oil and gas assets in the Permian Basin, expanding its footprint in the premier US shale region.
why: Diversified Energy acquires and optimizes mature hydrocarbon assets; this deal deepens its exposure to US onshore production.

impacts.name: Diversified Energy Company
impacts.why: Closing the $1.8B Permian Basin deal scales cash flow and producing acreage.
